CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_settings" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "avatarDisplayMode" TEXT DEFAULT 'ALWAYS',
  "avatarDisplayStyle" TEXT DEFAULT 'CIRCULAR',
  "tagStyles" TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
  "cheapLLMSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"strategy":"PROVIDER_CHEAPEST","fallbackToLocal":true,"allowCheapFallback":false,"embeddingProvider":"OPENAI"}',
  "imageDescriptionProfileId" TEXT,
  "defaultRoleplayTemplateId" TEXT,
  "themePreference" TEXT DEFAULT '{"activeThemeId":null,"colorMode":"system","showNavThemeSelector":false}',
  "sidebarWidth" INTEGER DEFAULT 256,
  "defaultTimestampConfig" TEXT DEFAULT '{"mode":"NONE","format":"FRIENDLY","useFictionalTime":false,"autoPrepend":true,"intervalMinutes":15}',
  "memoryCascadePreferences" TEXT DEFAULT '{"onMessageDelete":"ASK_EVERY_TIME","onSwipeRegenerate":"DELETE_MEMORIES"}',
  "autoHousekeepingSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":false,"perCharacterCap":2000,"perCharacterCapOverrides":{},"autoMergeSimilarThreshold":0.9,"mergeSimilar":false}',
  "memoryExtractionLimits" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":false,"maxPerHour":20,"softStartFraction":0.7,"softFloor":0.7}',
  "autonomousRoomSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"dailyTokenBudget":null,"defaultFreshnessWindowMs":43200000,"visibilityDefault":"owner_only","destructiveToolPolicy":"opt_in_per_room"}',
  "tokenDisplaySettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"showPerMessageTokens":false,"showPerMessageCost":false,"showChatTotals":false,"showSystemEvents":false}',
  "contextCompressionSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":true,"windowSize":5,"compressionTargetTokens":800,"systemPromptTargetTokens":1500,"projectContextReinjectInterval":5}',
  "llmLoggingSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":true,"verboseMode":false,"retentionDays":30}',
  "autoDetectRng" INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  "customTools" INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  "compositionModeDefault" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "composerSpellcheck" INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  "composerEmoji" INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  "composerUnicode" INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  "impersonationVoiceMode" TEXT DEFAULT 'off',
  "textReplacementsEnabled" INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  "autoScrollOnResponseComplete" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "agentModeSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"maxTurns":10,"defaultEnabled":false}',
  "coreWhisper" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":true,"interval":12,"silenceThreshold":3,"packetTokenBudget":4096,"fireOnContextTransition":true}',
  "thinkingDisplay" TEXT DEFAULT '{"defaultVisible":true,"defaultCollapsed":true}',
  "answerConfirmationSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":false}',
  "smartTypographySettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"displayQuotes":false,"dashes":true,"ellipsis":true}',
  "storyBackgroundsSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":false,"defaultImageProfileId":null}',
  "wardrobeImageSettings" TEXT,
  "conciergeSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":true,"autoSwitchAfterRefusals":2,"newChatsStartAs":"moderated","display":{"mode":"SHOW","showWarningBadges":true},"preScreen":{"enabled":false,"threshold":0.7,"scanTextChat":true,"scanImagePrompts":true,"scanImageGeneration":false,"summaryClassification":false}}',
  "autoLockSettings" TEXT DEFAULT '{"enabled":false,"idleMinutes":15}',
  "timezone" TEXT,
  "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_chat_settings_userId" ON "chat_settings" ("userId" ASC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_chat_settings_createdAt" ON "chat_settings" ("createdAt" DESC)
